_note: History of draft ideas the owner rejected or that a pick covers. Not a refusal: the rejected drafts were badly executed, not banned techniques, and the owner may like them done well. `ga drafts` prints the old draft id and archive path when a new draft's name matches a `match` phrase, and lists the pair in the round's DRAFTS.md and drafts.json so the old draft can be shown next to the new one. One row per old draft. kind: recycled (BRIEF-NEW-TECHNIQUES.md list, owner 2026-11-13: shown in some batch and rejected as recycled; applies to a new draft of any family), picked (a pick covers it; same family only), rejected (owner rejected the round; same family only). `match`: normalised phrases (lower case, words only) looked for in a draft name as whole words. `family`, `round`, `draft`, `draft_name`: where the old draft was found (its name matched `match` in the generator's catalog; a name match, not a recorded fact). `archive`: folder of that round under paths.anim_work (the archived copy is on the NAS under Modding/gorilla-akimbo/anim-work, and locally for some rounds); null where no old draft in the registered rounds matches. Owner review of the matches pending.
